purpose: Preferred interpretable model for prioritizing provider review for a material compliance finding in the next three fully observed months.
scoring_time: End of the current reporting month, after current-month compliance monitoring and material findings are known.

rationale.provider_descriptors: Provider type and region reduced out-of-time predictive performance and are retained only for segment auditing.
rationale.operational_scale: Absolute volume, staffing, caseload, and complaint-count fields added less value than normalized compliance measures and recent history.
rationale.current_material_finding: Retained because the scoring point is end-of-month and the current finding is known before forecasting the next 90 days.

safeguards: three-month embargo between training cutoff and test period
target requires all three future months to be observed
historical rolling features are shifted before aggregation
provider type and region are excluded from prediction and retained for audit
risk scores prioritize human review and do not establish noncompliance
all reported performance is synthetic-data methodology evidence, not a deployment claim
